Weather & Conditions

During the winter season, we post a conditions report at 5am each morning. Weather conditions change rapidly at Mt. Spokane. We recommend installing the NOAA weather app on your device to the most accurate forecasts and alerts. Visit NOAA Website.

NOAA EXTENDED FORECAST
Updated Tuesday, Nov 24


Hello mountain friends. We're feeling the holiday spirit up here and hope your week is off to a cozy start.


Thanksgiving week's forecast is bringing plenty of moisture, but it's looking like a rain/snow mix rather than the big, fluffy dump we're dreaming of. It's the wintery mix we love to see this time of year, but we'll need it to stack up enough to open on December 5. We've seen crazier things happen up here, so we're not counting anything out.


We'll wait and see what the holiday weekend brings. Check back here on the conditions report and our social channels for opening announcements. We'll continue weekly updates until we have a date, then switch to daily conditions. Keep an eye on the webcams in the meantime.


A Little Winter Under the Tree
Give the gift of winter! 5-Pack Lift Tickets, Learn to Ski packages and gift cards are all available online. Shop here.

﻿

Make Your Winter Plans
Group lessons and multi-week programs are open for booking. Passholders, remember to upload your photo and complete your waiver so your pass is ready and waiting on your first day.


Enjoy your turkey, your pie and your people this Thanksgiving. Keep those snow dances going. We'll see you soon!
